description: Changes one contact, named by id, by whichever of these are given: name (the name the business sets, which shows first; null goes back to the WhatsApp names; owners and admins only), attributes (field values by key), tags (the whole list, replacing the old one), locale, timezone, and is_blocked (true blocks the contact on their number so nothing is sent to them and their messages are not answered; false unblocks; owners and admins only). Writes only to Cosend: nothing is sent and the contact is not told. Returns the contact.

attributes.description: Free-form values, replaced whole on PATCH. A key registered in /v1/contact-fields must hold a value of its type (text: a string; number: a number; date: YYYY-MM-DD; boolean: true or false; choice: one of its choices) or null; a PATCH that sets attributes must give every required field a value. A key that is not registered is kept as it comes.

id.description: The id in the resource path.
